title: Count the bytes that cross
summary: Copy stdin into a pipe in chunks; the child counts until EOF.
hints: Parent: `while ((n = read(0, buf, sizeof buf)) > 0) write(p[1], buf, n);` then close `p[1]`. Write exactly `n` bytes, not the whole buffer.
Child: `while ((n = read(p[0], buf, sizeof buf)) > 0) total += n;`. `read` may return fewer bytes than the buffer size.
